summary: American Block Sniper Survival is a fast-paced FPS shooter with intense battles.
description:
Step into the pixelated battlegrounds where every shot counts and survival is the only option. With action-packed gameplay and a vast arsenal of cool weapons at your disposal, prepare for heart-pounding battles like never before. 

Explore diverse landscapes rendered in stunning pixel art as you navigate through the blocky terrain. Every corner holds new challenges, opportunities and powerful guns for epic victories where you can become the ultimate blocky sniper in this epic pixelated adventure! If you like pvp, multiplayer and battle royale games, you will enjoy this single player game. 

Get ready to experience the thrill of long-range sniping, strategic positioning, and intense shooting moments as you hold the line and defend yourself. 
With a thrilling mix of action-packed gameplay and strategic battles, American Block Sniper Survival is a shooter that delivers non-stop excitement from start to finish. 

Experience the ultimate adrenaline rush in the coolest FPS shooter game on mobile!
